title: Instantly Optimised
body:
**Instantly Optimised**

**Instantly Optimised** gives Minecraft a serious performance overhaul, cutting through lag and frame drops to deliver a smooth, responsive experience on any hardware. Perfect for players who want maximum FPS without sacrificing visuals or quality of life.

---

**✨ Features**

- **Boosted FPS & Optimised Rendering** for a smoother, stutter-free experience across all hardware
- **Extended Render Distance** beyond server limits using smart chunk caching
- **Shader Support** with full compatibility — beautiful visuals, zero performance guilt
- **Enhanced Player Models** with 3D skin layers rendered cleanly without any FPS cost
- **Utility & QoL Mods** including a detachable freecam, and many more hand-picked additions

---

*Drop it into your Modrinth instance, enable it, and enjoy the smoothest Minecraft you've ever played.*
